user.title: Add thermostat / TRV zone
user.description: Select one Moes/Tuya thermostat and one or more Sonoff TRVZB valves. Add the integration again for each additional room/zone.

data.mirror_frost_to_moes: Mirror Sonoff frost target on Moes while OFF

data_description.mirror_frost_to_moes: When enabled, Moes shows the Sonoff frost target while the zone is OFF. The real working target is stored separately and restored when heating starts.
data_description.frost_temperature: Used only before the real Sonoff OFF/frost target has been learned.
